name.zh: 受 Cooksonia 启发的稀疏顶囊裸轴

description.en: Use slender faceted forks and flattened terminal caps; choose a readable sparse arrangement as an art decision.
description.zh: 以细棱柱分叉和扁平顶囊建形；稀疏布局仅为美术选择。

sources.title: PLANTORIGINS-ITN

reconstruction_notes.en: Same stable Cooksonia ID restored from deferred unbuilt planning. Sparse naked Y-branching axes and flattened terminal spore capsules; no modern leaves, flowers or speculative root system. Nominal size, colors, axis/capsule count and layout are artistic, not exact species/specimen reconstruction.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 从延后未制作计划恢复的同一 Cooksonia 稳定ID。稀疏裸露Y形分叉与扁平顶生孢子囊；不添现代叶、花或推测根系。名义尺度、配色、枝囊数量及布局为美术选择，非精确物种或标本复原。

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
